_comment: How a stored dinner time reads: dinnerTimeLabel in nala-shared.js, and its
forced copy in index.html - the guest page loads no staff code, and since
28 Sep it tells an external guest the seating reception agreed on the
phone. CLAUDE.md rule 3: two copies of one rule are held to one table.
inv_suite runs every case through the shared copy, index_suite through
the guest page's. Each case: [stored, reads as]. A time that is not one
reads as nothing, never as text on a guest's screen or a kitchen sheet.
